run_slurm_pipeline: run a SlurmPipelineExecutor to download and convert a HuggingFace dataset to JSONL format
create_parquet_reader: create a ParquetReader that reads parquet files from a HuggingFace dataset with a specified text key and metadata
create_jsonl_writer: create a JsonlWriter that writes processed data to compressed JSONL files with configurable max file size
configure_slurm_executor: configure a SlurmPipelineExecutor with task count, CPU, memory, partition, and logging directory settings
build_dataset_download_pipeline: build a dataset download pipeline that reads from HuggingFace and writes to local JSONL output
